# Marilla Cuthbert

## Overview

- **Age:** Sixty years old  <sub>[v2 c17 P73](../source/v02-c17.md#nw-v02-c17-p0073)</sub>
- **Gender:** female  <sub>[v1 c1 P13](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0013)</sub>
- **Status:** alive  <sub>[v2 c29 P8](../source/v02-c29.md#nw-v02-c29-p0008)</sub>
- **Origin:** Avonlea, Green Gables  <sub>[v1 c1 P31](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0031), [v2 c17 P73](../source/v02-c17.md#nw-v02-c17-p0073)</sub>
- **Role:** Homemaker and farmer at Green Gables  <sub>[v1 c1 P8](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0008), [v2 c1 P29](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0029)</sub>
- **Titles:** Miss Cuthbert  <sub>[v1 c6 P5](../source/v01-c06.md#nw-v01-c06-p0005), [v1 c8 P11](../source/v01-c08.md#nw-v01-c08-p0011)</sub>

## Appearance

Marilla is a tall, thin woman with sharp angles, dark hair showing gray streaks, and no curves, wearing her hair twisted into a hard little knot fastened with two wire hairpins. Over time, her gaunt figure displays grayer hair, but her face softens in expression. As a child, she was dark and homely, a memory that stayed with her for fifty years.

_Sources: [v1 c1 P13](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0013), [v1 c9 P44](../source/v01-c09.md#nw-v01-c09-p0044), [v1 c33 P15](../source/v01-c33.md#nw-v01-c33-p0015)_

## Personality

Marilla is a practical, sensible, and stern woman of narrow experience and rigid conscience. Beneath her unromantic and strict exterior lies a dry sense of humor, a deep capacity for affection, and a soft heart that grows stronger through her care for Anne and the Keith twins. Though prone to pessimism and reluctant to display emotion openly, she is steadfastly determined, responsible, and self-contained.

_Sources: [v1 c1 P13](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0013), [v1 c3 P20](../source/v01-c03.md#nw-v01-c03-p0020), [v1 c9 P12](../source/v01-c09.md#nw-v01-c09-p0012), [v1 c26 P1](../source/v01-c26.md#nw-v01-c26-p0001), [v1 c30 P3](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0003), [v2 c19 P64](../source/v02-c19.md#nw-v02-c19-p0064), [v2 c29 P8](../source/v02-c29.md#nw-v02-c29-p0008)_

## History

Marilla Cuthbert lived at Green Gables in Avonlea for sixty years alongside her brother Matthew. When they arranged to adopt an orphan boy to help on the farm, a mistake resulted in the arrival of red-haired Anne Shirley. Though initially astonished and inclined to return her, Marilla decided to keep Anne and took full charge of her upbringing. Over time, Marilla developed a deep, devoted love for Anne despite her strict discipline and struggle to manage the girl's imaginative mishaps. Following Matthew's death and experiencing failing eyesight, she continued managing Green Gables with Anne's help. She later took in her third cousins, the orphaned twins Davy and Dora Keith, providing them with a home and discipline.

_Sources: [v1 c1 P31](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0031), [v1 c3 P0](../source/v01-c03.md#nw-v01-c03-p0000), [v1 c6 P34](../source/v01-c06.md#nw-v01-c06-p0034), [v1 c8 P5](../source/v01-c08.md#nw-v01-c08-p0005), [v1 c30 P3](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0003), [v1 c37 P28](../source/v01-c37.md#nw-v01-c37-p0028), [v2 c1 P29](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0029), [v2 c8 P1](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0001), [v2 c17 P73](../source/v02-c17.md#nw-v02-c17-p0073)_

## Background by volume

- grew up keeping still and obeying orders  <sub>[v2 c8 P4](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0004)</sub>

> Matthew Cuthbert, you don’t mean to say you think we ought to keep her!  <sub>[v1 c3 P56](../source/v01-c03.md#nw-v01-c03-p0056)</sub>
